items.a: An **orphan amendment** wasn't linked to its parent contract, so it never got counted.

items.q: Why was the act-by date wrong?
items.a: It used the **termination clause** instead of the **renewal clause**—the contract would have auto-renewed.
Amendments that **restate total value** get summed; the right answer is the **latest amendment's value**.

items.q: What did they build before letting the agent run?
items.a: A **five-stage pipeline**—OCR, classification, extraction, category mapping—so every answer could be **checked in code**.
In **custom tools and views** the agent calls, not just in the prompt.
Otherwise the agent reads a blocked lookup as **a real zero** and carries on.

items.q: What do parallel analyst agents need afterwards?
items.a: A **prescriptive dedupe step** so the same saving isn't counted twice.

items.q: What can't documents give the agent?
items.a: **Live business context**—like initiatives management already started.
